smtp.title: Global platform settings
smtp.intro: Configure FamilyGest's main public web address and the single SMTP server used to send every email (invitations, notifications) for all families.
smtp.serverUrl: Public URL of the application / server (base URL)
smtp.serverUrlHelp: Example: {example1} or {example2}. No trailing slash. This address is inserted into every invitation and notification email so members of each family can reach the application.

help.resend: Resend: create an API key on {site} after verifying your sending domain (SPF/DKIM). The SMTP username is literally {user}; the SMTP password is that API key ({key}).
help.brevoSmtp: Brevo (SMTP): free up to 300 emails/day, no credit card needed. Verify your sending domain (SPF/DKIM) on {site}, then generate an {smtpKey} (not the API key — they are two separate credentials) under SMTP & API settings. The SMTP username is your Brevo account email address; the SMTP password is the generated SMTP key.
help.brevoApi: Brevo (API): uses your Brevo {apiKey} directly ({prefix}, SMTP & API > API keys section) once your sending domain is verified (SPF/DKIM) — no separate SMTP credentials are needed in this mode, emails are sent through the Brevo REST API.

smtp.testRecipientHelp: A test email will be sent to this address to check deliverability.
smtp.testSuccess: Test successful! Connection to the global SMTP server confirmed.

digest.sendNowTitle: Immediately send the daily summary to subscribed users, without waiting for the scheduled time
digest.confirmMessage: An email/push will be sent immediately to every user who enabled the daily summary, regardless of the scheduled time.

google.title: Sign in with Google
google.intro: Lets members sign in with their Google account, if its email address is the one of their FamilyGest account (or of an invitation). Passwords remain usable.
google.guideTitle: Create the credentials at Google (once, free)

steps.project: Open the Google Cloud console and create a project (for example “FamilyGest”):
steps.consent: Menu “APIs & Services › OAuth consent screen” (or “Google Auth Platform”): type “External”, app name “FamilyGest”, your support address. The default scopes (email, profile) are enough.
steps.publish: In “Audience”, click “Publish app” (in production): otherwise only manually added test users can sign in. No Google verification is needed for these scopes.
steps.client: Menu “Credentials › Create credentials › OAuth client ID”, type “Web application”.
steps.redirect: Under “Authorized redirect URIs”, add the return address below, then create.
steps.copy: Copy the client ID and client secret here, tick “Enable” and save.

google.redirectUri: Return address to declare at Google

releases.title: Updates to publish
releases.intro: Each time a new version is available you get a notification. Review the new features, then publish them: every user is notified according to their preferences (push and/or email), and a “What's new?” window shows up the next time they open the app.
releases.confirmMessage: Notify all users about the ticked item of version {version}, according to their notification preferences? | Notify all users about the {n} ticked items of version {version}, according to their notification preferences?
releases.published: New features published: {push} push notification(s), {email} email(s).
releases.dismissed: Version dismissed: users will not be notified.
releases.chooseHint: Untick the items users do not need to know about (fixes, details): only ticked items are announced.
releases.selectedCount: {n} of {total} item will be announced | {n} of {total} items will be announced
releases.noneSelected: Tick at least one item, or choose “Don't publish”.

landing.title: Presentation page
landing.intro: A page presenting FamilyGest, at a secret address you share yourself (WhatsApp, email, QR code). Like the whole site, it is never indexed by search engines.
landing.regenerateMessage: A new secret address will be created: the old link will stop working for those who received it.
landing.contactHint: The contact does not appear in plain text in the page: it is only revealed on click, to avoid robots that harvest addresses.
landing.showContactHint: Keep it hidden while you only send the page to people who already have your contact details.
